_comment: No hand-typed color codes. All color must come from a token (var(--...)) or, inside app/styles/tokens.css, a literal that defines one. Existing files still carry pre-policy debt — see the audit report for the sweep plan — so this is enforced going forward via `npm run lint:css` rather than wired into `npm run lint` yet. Once the Phase 2 literal sweep lands, wire lint:css into the main lint script and CI.
